nodes.label: Decision: Gemini Rather Than Anthropic for the Reasoning Core
nodes.rationale: Access and cost. Kept behind lib/llm.ts so the architecture described in the proposal — an LLM reasoning core with native tool use — is unchanged regardless of vendor; also makes a mid-week provider swap a one-file change.
nodes.norm_label: decision: gemini rather than anthropic for the reasoning core

nodes.label: Decision: Online/Supabase Rather Than Local Postgres
nodes.rationale: Components are interconnected; an offline build would harness less capability. Mitigated by a phone hotspot as primary connectivity and a recorded real run as fallback.
nodes.norm_label: decision: online/supabase rather than local postgres

nodes.label: Decision: Gmail Live, Other Four Tool Categories Simulated
nodes.rationale: One genuinely live integration proves the pattern; four fragile OAuth integrations would risk the demo. Disclosed openly to judges rather than hidden.
nodes.norm_label: decision: gmail live, other four tool categories simulated

nodes.label: Decision: Gmail OAuth Pulled Forward to Day 1
nodes.rationale: Pulled forward three days before it is needed because Google's consent screen setup eats time unpredictably.
nodes.norm_label: decision: gmail oauth pulled forward to day 1

nodes.label: Decision: manualProcedure Added on Day 4
nodes.rationale: Costs half a day, directly answers the sponsor's stated thesis, and sits inside the proposal's existing promise that reasoning is attached to every action so approval is informed rather than rubber-stamp. Not a deviation.

nodes.label: Decision: Hard Code Freeze 6pm Day 7
nodes.rationale: A feature added the night before a demo is the most common way hackathon teams lose on stage.

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 1: Real Function Calling Only
nodes.rationale: An LLM that writes tool names as text is not tool use; it must go through native function-calling and dispatch real functions. This exact bug shipped once on 21 July and was caught late.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 1: real function calling only

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 2: Every Tool Call Persists a trail_steps Row
nodes.rationale: As it happens, not batched at the end — this table is the audit trail judges click through; failed calls are logged too.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 2: every tool call persists a trail_steps row

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 3: Every Decision Carries manualProcedure
nodes.rationale: Must read like a colleague teaching you the judgment, not a log of what happened — the sponsor wants an operator who can learn the process by watching and replicate it without the agent.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 3: every decision carries manualprocedure

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 4: The Agent Must Know When It Doesn't Know
nodes.rationale: Below the confidence threshold, route to ask_human rather than guessing; escalation message is structured (tried/found/unresolved/options/recommendation), never a bare 'I don't know.'
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 4: the agent must know when it doesn't know

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 5: Tool Selection Is Not a Fixed Sequence
nodes.rationale: The agent chooses which tools to call per case; a routine reminder might touch two, reconciliation should touch four. If the sequence is hardcoded, the side-by-side demo dies.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 5: tool selection is not a fixed sequence
